message.content:
A typical medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
Calories can vary depending on the size and variety:

| Size | Approximate weight | Calories |
|------|--------------------|----------|
| Small | ~80 g | ~15–18 |
| Medium | ~123 g | ~22 |
| Large | ~182 g | ~30–35 |

So you can expect anywhere from about 15 to 35 calories for most tomatoes you’ll find in a grocery store.
